concept.controls: Up/Down or W/S: Aim the catapult. Hold and release Space: Launch. Press Space in mid-air: Shield Drop. Enter: Start / Retry.
concept.core_mechanic: Shield Drop changes flight. A launched knight screams across the sky, and one timed press of Space cancels his arc and sends him straight down, shield-first. A clean drop smashes through two tower blocks, while a late drop bounces him harmlessly into the dirt. The drifting cloud is a trampoline: bounce off it to regain height and set up a perfect drop.
concept.juice: The catapult creaks and stretches as power builds, the knight does a squash-and-spin launch pose with a speed trail, and the cloud squishes with a soft boing bounce. Shield Drop adds a downward streak, a big dust ring, block chips, and a short screen shake. Each block knocked loose shows floating text like "CRACK!" and "TIMBER!"; dropping the dragon triggers slow, tumbling physics, gold sparkles from the chest, confetti, and a big "DRAGON DOWN!" banner. Title screen: the whole wobbly tower sways behind "KNIGHT FLIGHT" with "Press Enter to Launch!"
concept.lose: You have 5 knights. Run out before the dragon falls and the dragon waves from the top: "OUT OF KNIGHTS! The Dragon Keeps the Gold!"
concept.palette: Hand-drawn crayon storybook on sky blue and parchment. The bright blue cloud, red-plumed knight, brown catapult and tower, purple dragon, and golden chest pop against simple hills and puffy distant clouds.
concept.pitch: Launch the knight from the catapult, bounce him off a cloud, and slam him shield-first into the dragon's wobbly tower. Knock the dragon all the way to the ground to crack open the treasure chest.

roles.role: A drifting trampoline cloud the knight can bounce off to change his arc
The living cannonball, launched again and again
The player's aimable launcher on the left hill
The tall stack of physics blocks that creaks, wobbles, and collapses
The purple boss perched on top who must be knocked to the ground
The treasure prize beside the dragon; it bursts open when you win

concept.title: Knight Flight: Dragon Down!
concept.win: Knock the dragon off the tower and onto the ground: "DRAGON DOWN! You Got the Treasure!"
